name: Jurisdiction
definition: Specifies the jurisdiction (country, county, state, province, city).

GovernanceRules.name: Governance Rules
GovernanceRules.definition: Rules for which an applicable law and a jurisdiction are specified.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Specifies the jurisdiction (country, county, state, province, city).

RegisteredSecurities.name: Registered Securities
RegisteredSecurities.definition: Securities which are registered under a specific jurisdiction.

AssociatedStrategy.name: Associated Strategy
AssociatedStrategy.definition: Strategy which is based on a specific jurisdiction.

SecuritiesRestriction.name: Securities Restriction
SecuritiesRestriction.definition: Securities restrictions which apply in a specific jurisdiction.

RelatedSecuritiesTax.name: Related Securities Tax
RelatedSecuritiesTax.definition: Securities tax for which a jurisdiction is specified.

RelatedMarket.name: Related Market
RelatedMarket.definition: Market to which the jurisdiction is related.

RelatedAgreement.name: Related Agreement
RelatedAgreement.definition: Agreement which is subject to a specific jurisdiction.
